title: No More Fool Recruits: Villager Recruits
description: Better Pathfinding and Smart AI for talhanation's Villager Recruits Mod!
body:
No More Fool Recruits is A Add-on for [talhanation's](https://modrinth.com/user/talhanation) [Villager Recruits](https://modrinth.com/mod/villager-recruits) Mod!

# ADD-ON FEATURES

## 🧠 Advanced Environmental Awareness

Block-Aware Pathfinding: Recruits are no longer blind to danger. They actively recognize lethal blocks like Lava, Fire, Campfires, and Cacti as restricted zones and will dynamically path around them.
Smart Trapdoor Interaction: Navigating through attics and basements is no longer an issue! Recruits will automatically open closed trapdoors blocking their path or above their heads while climbing.
Obstacle Breaker: Traveling through dense forests or abandoned mineshafts? While marching, recruits will actively chop down Leaves and break through Cobwebs that block their path to keep the formation moving smoothly.

## 🧗 Smart Climber System (Ladder Fixes)

Vanilla Minecraft's ladder physics are clunky, but your recruits aren't. When approaching a ladder or vine, recruits now center themselves perfectly.
They actively push themselves up ladders and, more importantly, can gracefully slide down ladders without taking fall damage or getting stuck at the edges.

## 🏃 Dynamic Movement & Combat AI

Sprint to Target: If you order your recruits to move to a location more than 10 blocks away, they will automatically cast a Speed II boost and sprint into battle.
Creeper Panic (Survival Instinct): Your army will no longer stand still and get wiped out by a single explosion. If an ignited Creeper is detected within 6 blocks, recruits will momentarily cancel their orders and sprint away in the opposite direction to survive.

## 🎯 Flawless Command Execution

Raycast Move Command: Pointing the "Move" command at a steep wall or the sky no longer breaks their pathfinding. The add-on dynamically raycasts vertically to find the absolute closest valid floor, ensuring your troops always find their way.
True Indoor Formations (Heightmap Fix): Fixed a major base-mod bug where ordering "Follow Me" indoors would send your recruits to the roof or the top of nearby trees. They now perfectly track your local elevation.
Anti-Stuck Teleportation: If Minecraft's pathfinding completely fails and a recruit remains hopelessly stuck for 7 seconds, they will dynamically teleport to their assigned destination with a sleek portal particle effect. No recruit gets left behind!
